variants.headline: Looking back: people leave the colony on the ship
variants.sub: The ship has taken away young adults with no work and families with no home.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: People have left the colony on the ship: young adults without work and families without homes.

Our principles should be able to face a departure without demanding that people justify their attachment to the colony. Work and a home are ordinary conditions of a life. A political argument about belonging deserves to take those conditions seriously rather than substitute an appeal to loyalty for practical responsibility.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We hold {target} to account critically. A colony should not ask loyalty to stand in for work or a home, and the departure deserves a demanding assessment of the practical stewardship behind belonging.
